summary: Defines an interoperability profile for the user equipment, such as videophones and apps, used with Video Relay Service. In that service a sign language user talks over video with an interpreter, who then speaks with the hearing person by telephone. The profile aims to let different vendors' equipment and relay providers work together. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Some deaf people use video calls to talk with an interpreter who then phones the other person. This document is the rulebook so any brand of video phone can connect to any relay service.

questions: what is video relay service interoperability
how do videophones work with relay services
